text:
elaine: Quick thread 1 working on the "SDK export example" for SOC2 docs. Need a short curl + python example showing how a tenant requests an audit export and a few lines about redaction/consent. cc @pete @ryan

pete: Keep the examples minimal. Show endpoint /v1/audit/exports and include a query param for date range and a header X-Redwood-Export-Consent. Mention the legal/exceptions link.

ryan: For SOC2 wording: say 'exports are produced on request; platform follows audit_retention schedules. Exports may exclude tenant-owned content unless explicitly requested.' Simple and non-legalese.

elaine: draft curl snippet i'm thinking:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \ 
  -H "X-Redwood-Export-Consent: true" \ 
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports?start=2024-01-01&end=2024-01-31&format=jsonl"
```

elaine: and python SDK example (very small):

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
rc = RedwoodClient(api_key="$API_KEY")
resp = rc.audit.exports(start="2024-01-01", end="2024-01-31", consent=True)
print(resp.download_url)
```

pete: nice. add one-line note that exported payloads will hash or truncate PII by default unless customer includes signed consent statement. Also say export artifacts are retained per customer agreement.

ryan: Also call out transfer protections: exports delivered over pre-signed URL with short TTL, and customers can request SFTP transfer for large exports. Good to mention in the doc.

elaine: wording suggestion for the paragraph: "Audit exports are available to customers upon request. Exports reflect platform audit retention policies (audit_retention). Exported audit records may have payloads redacted or hashed to protect personal data; customers can provide explicit consent for fuller exports in coordination with Support and legal. Records required by law or under legal hold may be retained beyond standard retention windows."

link-bot: Automated link check: https://redwood.internal/docs/soc2/exports -> 200 OK

elaine: thanks bot. I'll add the snippets to the export section and open a tiny PR. tagging @pete @ryan for a quick look once it's up.

pete: :thumbsup: one nit - change 'fuller exports' -> 'unredacted exports'

ryan: approve after that nit. Also add a short line on how to request a legal hold (contact support with case id).

elaine: will update and push in ~20m. Thanks!
